_comment: Everything that belongs to THIS installation: keys, ids and paths. Laid over config.json at startup, so an update can take a fresh config.json without typing any of this back in. NEVER share this file - and it is in .gitignore for that reason.

local.galaxyPath: FILL IN (local mode): the folder with the galaxy and its logs

discordUserIds: FILL IN: your Discord user id

ai.apiKey: FILL IN if the companion is on
